title: Protocol Analytics
tagline: Analytics dashboards for Gearbox Protocol and Polygon DEX activity
description:
This project provides analytics insights into the Gearbox and Polygon protocols.



The Gearbox dashboard presents an overview of active Gearbox Credit Accounts (CA), CA DEX activity and CA Yearn activity.

https://dune.com/niftytable/Gearbox



The Polygon dashboard presents a detailed breakdown of DEX trading activity on the Polygon chain.

https://dune.com/hildobby/Polygon-DEXs
how_its_made: This project uses Dune analytics to crunch the data on contract calls and events and to create visualizations. Specifically, contract events on the Gearbox protocol and on the DEXs of Polygon were used to construct live stat counters and charts breaking down usage, health and growth metrics.
